arguments.sql:
WITH issued_cards AS (
    SELECT card.card_id,
           card.issued,
           disp.client_id,
           client.birth_date,
           client.district_id AS client_district_id,
           account.district_id AS account_district_id,
           district.district_id AS matched_district_id
    FROM card
    LEFT JOIN disp ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    LEFT JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
    LEFT JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
    LEFT JOIN district ON district.district_id = client.district_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', card.issued) = '1994'
       OR substr(card.issued, 1, 4) = '1994'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT issued_cards.client_id) AS client_count,
       COUNT(issued_cards.matched_district_id) AS matched_district_count,
       SUM(issued_cards.client_district_id <> issued_cards.account_district_id) AS different_district_count,
       MIN(issued_cards.issued) AS first_issue,
       MAX(issued_cards.issued) AS last_issue,
       SUM(strftime('%Y', issued_cards.issued) IS NULL) AS unparsed_issue_count,
       SUM(strftime('%Y', issued_cards.birth_date) IS NULL) AS unparsed_birth_count
FROM issued_cards

arguments.sql:
WITH account_loans AS (
    SELECT loan.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           SUM(loan.amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY loan.account_id
),
cardholders AS (
    SELECT client.client_id,
           client.gender,
           client.birth_date,
           card.type AS card_type,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', card.issued) AS INTEGER)
               - CAST(strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_issue,
           COALESCE(account_loans.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
           COALESCE(account_loans.total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
           district.A2 AS district_name,
           district.A11 AS district_average_salary
    FROM card
    JOIN disp ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
    LEFT JOIN district ON district.district_id = client.district_id
    LEFT JOIN account_loans ON account_loans.account_id = disp.account_id
    WHERE card.issued >= '1994-01-01'
      AND card.issued < '1995-01-01'
)
SELECT cardholders.client_id,
       cardholders.gender,
       cardholders.birth_date,
       cardholders.card_type,
       cardholders.age_at_issue,
       cardholders.loan_count,
       cardholders.total_amount_borrowed,
       CASE
           WHEN cardholders.loan_count > 0 AND cardholders.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
           WHEN cardholders.loan_count > 0 AND cardholders.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
           ELSE 'Non-borrower'
       END AS borrower_classification,
       cardholders.district_name,
       cardholders.district_average_salary,
       RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY cardholders.gender
           ORDER BY cardholders.age_at_issue DESC
       ) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM cardholders
ORDER BY cardholders.client_id
